svg.title: FROM SIGNAL TO FRONTIER - Holographic Basalt Relief
svg.desc: Uncertain observations become bounded, inspectable machine action - then earn the right to move farther from supervision. The composition reads left to right through signal, world, body, authority, evidence, frontier. Solid luminous lines indicate direct evidence, dashed lines indicate conceptual or conditional relationships, and translucent elements indicate a future thesis. The 84-second animation explains sensing, routing, authorization, verification, or exploration and stops when reduced motion is requested.

g.text: Uncertain observations become bounded, inspectable machine action - then earn the right to move farther from supervision.
